summary: SOLAI Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a definitive Share Exchange Agreement to acquire a 51% equity stake in NEURALAND PTE. LTD. The consideration is 1,162,025,300 newly issued Class A ordinary shares valued at US$0.0079 per share (US$0.79 per ADS), totaling ~US$9.18 million, priced on the 30-day VWAP of SOLAI's ADS. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned; the chairman expressed support. The all-stock deal reflects a strategic pivot to AI. The transaction is subject to closing conditions; investors should monitor shareholder approval and regulatory clearance timelines.
